title: Kirk Cousins on Raiders QBs: We're all supporting one another and working together

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kirk Cousins on Raiders QBs: We're all supporting one another and working together
sources.description: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak was clear with reporters on Tuesday that Kirk Cousins is Las Vegas’ starter, with No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza a part of the group pushing the signal-caller.
